0.name: THE ROOM
0.desc: Start here. A quiet evening room, and you at normal size.
0.label: NAKED EYE

1.name: THE BOOKSHELF
1.desc: Book spines stand like tall walls, with gold lettering on every one.
1.label: NAKED EYE

2.name: THE PILE
2.desc: Each carpet tuft is a tower, and a crumb lies like a fallen log.
2.label: NAKED EYE

3.name: YARN ROPES
3.desc: Strands of yarn rise as thick twisted ropes. A dust ball rolls past.
3.label: NAKED EYE

4.name: THREAD FOREST
4.desc: Fabric fibres rise like cables. Specks of dust drift by like moons.
4.label: NAKED EYE

5.name: DROPLET WORLD
5.desc: One drop of water, as big as a hill, with tiny life swimming inside.
5.label: LIGHT MICROSCOPE

6.name: BACTERIA GARDEN
6.desc: Rod-shaped cells lie like logs, and whip-like tails wave through the water.
6.label: LIGHT MICROSCOPE

7.name: GERM REEF
7.desc: Bacteria loom like islands. Viruses drift past like landers.
7.label: ELECTRON MICROSCOPE

8.name: PROTEIN FACTORY
8.desc: Ribosomes bob along a chain of beads, building proteins.
8.label: ELECTRON MICROSCOPE

9.name: DNA FOREST
9.desc: Spiral towers with coloured rungs fill the horizon.
9.label: X-RAY DIFFRACTION

10.name: CRYSTAL LATTICE
10.desc: As small as an atom. You stand on one, in a glowing grid.
10.label: TUNNELLING MICROSCOPE

11.name: ELECTRON CLOUDS
11.desc: Glowing lobes of probability float over a flat platform.
11.label: BOHR RADIUS

12.name: GAMMA SEA
12.desc: Gamma rays from radioactive atoms have waves about as long as you are tall.
12.label: CAESIUM-137, 662 KEV

13.name: THE GREAT EMPTY
13.desc: Faint orbits sweep around a speck of a nucleus, far away.
13.label: RUTHERFORD 1911

14.name: NUCLEUS CITY
14.desc: A tight cluster of particles packs together like a city block.
14.label: NUCLEAR SIZES

15.name: INSIDE THE PROTON
15.desc: Three quarks, tied together by glowing strings.
15.label: PROTON RADIUS

16.name: FIRST QUARKS
16.desc: Fast electrons bounce off tiny hard points inside a proton.
16.label: SLAC 1968

17.name: SHORT REACH
17.desc: The weak force reaches only about 1/700th of a proton.
17.label: W BOSON MASS

18.name: RIPPLE SEA
18.desc: A passing gravitational wave stretched LIGO's arms by about two of you.
18.label: LIGO 2015

19.name: COLLISION HALL
19.desc: The LHC reaches this small. Quarks still show no parts inside.
19.label: LHC 13.6 TEV

35.name: PLANCK FOAM
35.desc: About the Planck length, where physicists expect today's theories to stop working.
35.label: PLANCK LENGTH

void.name: UNEXPLORED
void.desc: No experiment has looked this small. Nothing is known to exist here.
void.label: NO DATA · NOTHING MEASURED HERE
